source: Hedonic model of yearly asking rent per m² on 1,558 Aqar listings (apartments, floors, villas) in Al-Rabie and 18 neighbouring north-Riyadh districts, with each listing's detail page (age, facade, street width, furnishing), 2026-10-29. Only effects whose 90% bootstrap range stays on one side of zero are kept; fields Aqar fills unevenly (air conditioning, yard, maid's room, entrances, lift) are left out because their effect reflected which ads fill them, not the feature.
unit: percent change in price per m² against the comparable listings, which mix ages, streets and furnishing
